text:
ci-bot: perf-check: PR 7211 failed perf gate on eng-runtime microbench (batcher_throughput).
Details: -2.7% vs baseline (threshold -1.0%). Report: https://ci.example.com/artifacts/7211/perf.html

alex: ugh. saw that in the dashboard. anyone tracking recent merges? cc @maria @liam

maria: I started a quick local profile against the same trace. KV cache hitrate dropped from ~85% to ~72% after the latest merges. looks suspicious.

liam: can we bisect to confirm which commit introduced this? if it's a kernel selection tweak we should revert fast.

alex: running the perf bisection now: `./scripts/ci_perf_bisect --range=7200..7211 --bench=batcher_throughput --ci` will post results in a bit.

alex: bisect finished: regression introduced by commit 7208 — "kernel affinity: prefer_numa=true". Candidate 7208 -> delta -2.69% on batcher_throughput.

maria: profiling details show more context switches and cache invalidations around the kernel handoff. snippet from perf summary:
```
syscalls: context_switches +15240
kv_cache: hit_rate 85.1% -> 72.3%
cache_flushes +4231
```
This matches the throughput drop.

sam: hmm. affinity tweak probably moved small/short-lived KV workers onto different cores causing more cross-core cache traffic. Options: revert 7208, or scope affinity to exclude KV-heavy paths.

liam: revert seems safest to unblock rollout. then follow up with a targeted affinity patch + perf test. anyone object?

alex: creating a revert PR now — PR 7220 (revert: 7208). Adding perf diffs and the bisect log to the description. https://git.example.com/r/7220

deploybot: created PR 7220 and queued CI: https://ci.example.com/runs/7220

maria: I'll add a microbench regression test that asserts kv hitrate doesn't drop >3% on our standard traces.

sam: :thumbsup: good plan. after revert we should add a changelog note and a follow-up design doc for affinity heuristics that considers KV cache locality.

alex: will monitor the perf checks. if CI passes on 7220 I'll merge and rollout a revert ASAP.

ci-bot: CI perf run for PR 7220 started. Patch-level microbench scheduled.

maria: logging the bisect artifacts here for curious folks: /artifacts/bisect/7208_bisect.log

sam: thanks all — nice quick triage. once revert lands we'll open a new issue to rework affinity rules with tests.
